description: Turn down a return the customer requested: its status moves from requested to rejected, a final state, and its items become free for another return. No stock or money moves. Refused unless the return is requested or once it carries a refund. approve_return accepts the request instead; cancel_return withdraws a requested or approved return. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

orderId.description: The id of the order the return belongs to (from list_orders)

name: reject_return
title: Reject return
